# spdlog

Logging library used by Ellindyer World Forge.

## Required Files

Place the spdlog source tree into this directory:

    spdlog/
    └── include/
        └── spdlog/
            ├── spdlog.h
            ├── common.h
            ├── ... (all headers)
            └── fmt/
                └── bundled/
                    └── format.h
